statement: Road contact with a mapped public-road layer is not a recorded legal entrance. Generate questions for title or counsel about the deed, a recorded easement, the entrance location, maintenance duty, and exceptions. Do not state that a right exists, is missing, or is defective.
source_title: Access questions for title/counsel (CPER trial card)
source_publisher: RangeMatch trial card — not an official knowledge base
review_basis: Provisional CPER test only; questions, not legal advice.
